statement: Hook architecture: 20 concern packages under .opencode/hooks/<concern>/<runtime>/, 29 hooks in hook-registry.json bound across four JSON runtimes (claude 21, codex 18, cursor 17, devin 21), with pi carrying a registry entry and no file at all.

Six concerns reach every runtime (completion, dispatch, mcp-route-guard, post-edit-quality, skill-advisor, spec-gate); three reach five of six (session-lifecycle lacks opencode, session-cleanup lacks pi, task-dispatch lacks codex).
evidence: shell concern x runtime directory census

statement: Four hook absences are correct by nature and were already named by the Hermes parity work: codex-watchdog (OpenCode), directive-lifecycle (Claude), permission-policy (Devin, the only PermissionRequest host), hook-install; sk-vision absent for Claude is likewise documented ('Claude has no sk-vision integration').

Hook parity is the most complete surface in this research: after correcting two mechanism differences (Cursor reaches sk-vision through .cursor/rules/sk-vision.md rather than an adapter dir; Pi bundles dist-freshness, git-hooks-check, git-worktree-guard and git-primary-reconcile inside session-start-advisories.ts), the set of unported hooks is empty.

Pi's hook layer is the least protected surface: 'native code, not config' hand-authored extensions/*.ts, no hooks.json dialect, no registry bindings, and no drift checker — a shared-core behavior change surfaces only at runtime or in the manual-testing playbook. This compounds the two unwired Pi --check modes from iteration 6.

Hermes answers hook parity with a six-point bridge table in its plugin (pre_llm_call, pre_tool_call, transform_tool_result, pre_verify, on_session_start, four system-prompt sections, on_session_end) onto repo guard cores; every hook fails open, and the post-edit core deliberately runs in transform_tool_result because both hooks run on bounded worker threads and a post-hook stage would race the transform.

One flag vocabulary spans every runtime's hook adapter: hook-flags.env documents a master switch plus 22 per-concern switches read by shared hook-flags.{cjs,mjs,ts,sh}, with env overriding file. It is the only cross-runtime hook contract shared verbatim rather than translated.
